stepTitle: If Wesley refit the same model with $$(x_{i1})**{6}$$ as an additional feature, a unique solution will no longer exist.
stepBody: Wesley has $$n=30$$ unique data points and $$2$$ features. He fits the following OLS model:\n$$\hat{y}_i=\hat{\theta}_0+\hat{\theta}_1(x_{i1})**{3}+\hat{\theta}_{2}\log(x_{i2})$$\nWesley correctly calculates a unique optimal solution for his OLS model. Select all statements about Wesley's fitted model (which uses the optimal parameters) that must be true.
